datasets.name: TCGA-BRCA via cBioPortal
datasets.access: public cBioPortal exploration/API where permitted by study
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Good for external subtype/genomic sanity checks; not a treatment-cycle monitoring dataset.
use_in_project: Candidate external validation for biomarker feature extraction
limitations: Tumor-marker blood values such as CA 15-3 / CA 27.29 are generally not the main TCGA-BRCA signal.
datasets.license_or_terms: Follow source study and cBioPortal data-use terms.
datasets.source_evidence: cBioPortal hosts TCGA and curated cancer studies for visualization, analysis, and download.

datasets.name: METABRIC breast cancer via cBioPortal
datasets.access: public cBioPortal exploration/API where permitted by study
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Strong candidate for biomarker/subtype predictor benchmarking, but not a longitudinal monitoring dataset.
limitations: Does not provide OncoTrack-style chat symptoms, CBC nadirs, or serial upload workflow.
Feature names and availability vary by cBioPortal study version.
datasets.source_evidence: METABRIC is a commonly used public breast cancer clinical/genomic cohort surfaced through cBioPortal.

datasets.name: AACR GENIE BPC Breast Cancer v1.0-public
datasets.access: subset through GENIE cBioPortal; complete post-processed data through Synapse
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Highest-value real-world biomarker source for future predictor integration, but access may require Synapse workflow.
use_in_project: Future external benchmark for biomarker-informed response modeling
limitations: Access and licensing workflow may be more involved than cBioPortal-only data.
Not appropriate for patient-facing claims without clinical validation.
datasets.license_or_terms: Follow AACR GENIE, Synapse, and PRISSMM licensing requirements.
datasets.source_evidence: AACR describes 1,130 breast cancer patients with genomic, pathology, imaging, oncology-evaluation, ER/PR/HER2, Oncotype, multigene-signature, and selected biomarker fields.

datasets.name: BreastDCEDL
datasets.access: public research dataset; derivative license CC BY-NC 4.0
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Best local imaging-response benchmark with HR/HER2 metadata; not a serum tumor-marker dataset.
limitations: License is non-commercial due to source constraints.
datasets.license_or_terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 derivative dataset; honor source TCIA licenses.
datasets.source_evidence: Dataset page reports 2,070 DCE-MRI patients with pCR, HR, HER2, age, and race metadata.

datasets.name: NCI-EDRN Breast Cancer Reference Set
datasets.access: research reference-set/samples; availability through EDRN procedures
target_fields: breast cancer vs benign/no-evidence groups in the reference-set publication
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Useful for circulating-marker realism and cautionary evidence; not a treatment-response monitoring dataset.
use_in_project: Negative-result realism: markers may not distinguish benign from cancer reliably
limitations: Publication emphasizes limited diagnostic utility of tested circulating markers.
Not a longitudinal metastatic monitoring cohort with treatment cycles.
datasets.source_evidence: EDRN reports a multicenter reference set and 90 protein-marker analysis including CA15-3/CEACAM5-related markers.

datasets.name: SEER breast cancer biomarker fields
datasets.fit_for_oncotrack: Good population prior source for subtype/stage distributions; not patient-level monitoring.
limitations: Registry data, not an imaging/CBC/symptom timeline.
Not suitable for autonomous treatment-response monitoring claims.
datasets.source_evidence: SEER includes breast biomarker variables and training documentation for ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 concepts.

next_step: Map one public source at a time into an external predictor table. Start with BreastDCEDL HR/HER2/pCR because this project already has BreastDCEDL tooling, then add TCGA/METABRIC receptor/genomic fields. Treat serum tumor-marker sources as cautionary/supportive evidence unless a longitudinal treatment-response cohort is available.
claim_boundary: This manifest identifies public predictor sources. It does not mean OncoTrack has clinically validated biomarker or tumor-marker predictors.
